svg.aria-label: Operational and analytical systems: applications write to operational databases (OLTP); an ETL or ELT pipeline copies the data into a data warehouse or data lake, where analysts, dashboards and data scientists query it (OLAP); reverse ETL sends results back into the operational systems.
